Triage (first-touch grading): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`, `domain:ui`, type Task. Rationale: both halves are covered by standing discipline, so no ruling is needed — #5533 already established for this exact page that a request the page knows it will discard should be skipped, and handing a refused viewer the server's load-failure diagnosis instead of the refusal is an ordering defect against that same posture. The fix is a guard reorder (decide `!isAdmin` before firing the loads) plus the refusal-first render; the server stays the authority — this only stops the client doing work it will throw away. Not security-sensitive per the card's own assessment (catalog data, server-side authz intact), so no decision-box detour.

Dispatch notes: `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` was fenced read-only by in-flight #5557 (PR #5582) — serialize after that PR lands, and re-verify the line numbers on the merged ref. Size/model suggestion: S–M.
